category_audit.rationale: Current identity resolution and Foundation reading are publicly callable but remain repository-local and claim-bounded.
Task148 defines a read-only provenance-preserving collision operation with canonical function and non-function checks.
Current operations validate evidence links and coordinate research obligations; no general direct-source retrieval or autonomous research operation is separately registered.
Identity resolution and claim-gate validation are Current bounded operations and preserve independent maturity and evidence axes.
Mechanisms and model mappings may be classified and governed inside collision and claim validation, but no dedicated general model-mapping operation exists.
Collision can expose bounded gaps and questions and REOS LIGHT can coordinate them; no unconstrained synthesis or discovery operation is registered.
The Current writing transformation and bounded publication-surface validator are both registered, while publication acceptance remains outside their authority.
The Current language-thought plane supports bounded meaning projection with framing delta and unmapped residue.
Five public bounded validators cover claim, evidence, repository checkpoint, REOS LIGHT and publication surfaces without substantive authority upgrades.
Read-only maintenance is bounded and explicit Ignition self-change is Current only through the Iteration Method and its authorization gates.
The Reference Executor is REFERENCE_ONLY and live external invocation is OWNER_DEFERRED, so neither receives a callable playbook.

excluded_status_only.reason: REFERENCE_ONLY is a conformance boundary, not a Current public executor.
OWNER_DEFERRED with zero validated completions; explicit Owner reopening and Current admission remain absent.
HISTORICAL and superseded by the Current Iteration Method 1.4.0.
UNSUPPORTED because no REOS FULL runtime exists.

common_natural_language_intents: 这个旧编号现在对应什么？
请确认这个函数、断言或 alias 的 Current identity。
execution_steps: Freeze the exact reference and Current ref.
Run exact Current identity, alias, correction and migration resolution.
Return the canonical identity with disposition, record hash and claim ceiling, or fail closed.
stop_conditions: Current identity authority is unavailable or inconsistent.
The reference is ambiguous or has no validated Current mapping.
prohibitions: Do not use fuzzy similarity, historical files or model memory as identity authority.
Do not turn canonical registration into truth, proof or external validity.

common_natural_language_intents: 先恢复点火最新 Current 状态。
这个仓库当前是什么身份、任务和开放义务？
execution_steps: Freeze the observable repository ref or commit.
Read the AI cold-start entry, Current Facts, Current Snapshot and open obligations.
Return identity, lifecycle, method, map and a bounded next-read plan.
stop_conditions: The repository or exact Current ref cannot be read.
Current authorities conflict and cannot be reconciled.
prohibitions: Do not replace Current with memory or an old task record.
Do not execute a domain operation or infer external truth from Current recovery.

common_natural_language_intents: 用点火跑一遍这篇笔记。
把这个案例或论证与点火 Current 资产碰撞。
execution_steps: Freeze object provenance and split source facts, claims, interpretations, mechanisms and questions.
Search and verify both Current function and non-function canonical registries.
Classify actual relationships and separate source-derived content from post-collision increments.
Apply the candidate-new, source-overlap and pseudo-quantification gates before rendering.
stop_conditions: Object provenance or request-object boundary is unresolved.
Required canonical registries are unavailable.
A candidate lacks actual nearest-match evidence or source-overlap review.
prohibitions: Do not relabel an input-explicit viewpoint as an Ignition discovery.
Do not invent undefined scores, auto-register candidates, mutate repositories or perform external actions.

common_natural_language_intents: 把这个受约束结果投影到 Knowledge 视图。
检查这份 epistemic correction 能否形成知识结果投影。
execution_steps: Verify the result record, provenance and existing epistemic status.
Read the Knowledge Pack and Current Knowledge Experience manifest.
Render only the bounded projection and its validation findings.
stop_conditions: The result has no source-bound status or provenance.
Projection would increase claim, evidence, proof or acceptance status.
prohibitions: Do not treat Pack Bus routing as hook execution.
Do not persist a repository change in READ_ONLY_RUN or upgrade epistemic state.

common_natural_language_intents: 点火 Foundation 里怎样定义这个对象？
请从 Current Foundation 找相关资产和来源。
execution_steps: Resolve the query to Current Foundation and Knowledge entrances.
Read only the required canonical sources and preserve source paths.
Return a source-bounded summary with unresolved or quarantined boundaries.
stop_conditions: No Current canonical source can be identified.
The query would require inventing an unregistered object or authority.
prohibitions: Do not treat navigation, summaries or registry closure as proof.
Do not execute Pack hooks or silently promote quarantined assets.

common_natural_language_intents: 核查这个断言最多能说到哪里。
检查这个函数或命题的定义、证据和 claim ceiling。
execution_steps: Freeze the minimal atomic claim and classify its claim layer.
Resolve linked function and non-function identities and run applicable governance gates.
Return PASS, FAIL, REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW or NOT_APPLICABLE per gate and preserve the lowest ceiling.
stop_conditions: The claim cannot be isolated from the source object.
Required definitions, identity or authority are unavailable; report the missing obligation instead.
prohibitions: Do not infer an unautomatable PASS.
Do not merge mathematical maturity with external evidence or turn validation into truth.

common_natural_language_intents: 这条来源真的支持这个具体断言吗？
检查 claim-to-source 的 provenance 和范围。
execution_steps: Freeze the exact claim, source record and locator.
Check provenance, exact support relation, scope and evidence class.
Return a valid link, missing evidence or scope mismatch without substantive confirmation.
stop_conditions: The source body or claim-specific locator is unavailable.
The relation cannot distinguish source presence from exact support.
prohibitions: Do not treat a URL or citation as evidence for every nearby claim.
Do not infer truth, replication or acceptance from link validity.

common_natural_language_intents: 把这段内容翻译并保留概念边界。
比较源语言与目标语言的 framing delta。
execution_steps: Freeze source text, source profile, target language and intended use.
Normalize a bounded meaning candidate and project the target form.
Return framing delta, unmapped residue and human-review needs.
stop_conditions: Source or target language profiles are unavailable.
Loss, ambiguity or context cannot be represented without human review.
prohibitions: Do not claim language-independent universal meaning or guaranteed literary quality.
Do not erase unmapped residue or let translation raise truth status.

common_natural_language_intents: 只读检查这个仓库的结构或状态。
给出离线 maintenance proposal，不要修改。
execution_steps: Bind the declared repository snapshot and inspection scope.
Run only offline read-only checks allowed by the Maintenance Pack.
Return findings and a non-executing maintenance proposal.
stop_conditions: The path is outside the declared scope or snapshot.
The requested check requires network access, mutation or an unavailable authority.
prohibitions: Do not mutate local or remote repository state.
Do not treat a proposal or Pack route as executed maintenance.

common_natural_language_intents: 校验这个 repository checkpoint。
确认这份离线回执是否与当前快照一致。
execution_steps: Bind checkpoint identity, repository snapshot and claimed evidence.
Run declared boundary and state checks without publication.
Return exact mismatches, bounded PASS evidence or fail-closed status.
stop_conditions: Checkpoint identity or source snapshot cannot be bound.
Validation requires remote mutation or missing evidence.
prohibitions: Do not publish, push or mutate remote Git.
Do not equate checkpoint PASS with merged, Current, deployed, accepted or externally valid.

common_natural_language_intents: 请修改点火并建立 Draft PR。
给点火增加、删除或调整一个正式能力。
execution_steps: Confirm explicit repository-mutation authorization and route into ITERATION.md.
Recover remote truth, define the gap and claim ceiling, and compute propagation scope.
Implement bounded candidate changes, validate, review and preserve Draft lifecycle receipts.
stop_conditions: The current request does not explicitly authorize changing Ignition.
Remote truth, clean isolated workspace, propagation authority or required validation is unavailable.
Ready, merge or close would require Owner authority not present in the request.
prohibitions: Do not infer mutation authority from a repository URL or input object.
Do not modify protected main directly, force-push, auto-merge, mark Ready or claim Draft as Current.
Do not infer external action or epistemic acceptance from repository change.

common_natural_language_intents: 把这项研究拆成有依赖的证据义务。
用 REOS LIGHT 协调负结果、review 和 handoff。
execution_steps: Confirm that obligation coordination is needed beyond direct research.
Build a bounded obligation DAG with references, statuses and stop conditions.
Return case status and a typed handoff bundle while preserving negative results.
stop_conditions: A direct bounded answer is sufficient and REOS control would add no value.
Required obligation identity, references or handoff fields are missing.
prohibitions: Do not invent REOS FULL or a recovery layer.
Do not treat process completion, Agent agreement or Pack routing as truth or publication acceptance.

common_natural_language_intents: 校验这次 REOS LIGHT run 的结构。
检查 research case state 和 typed handoff 是否闭合。
execution_steps: Bind the REOS LIGHT run, case state and referenced obligations.
Validate graph, states, review and typed handoff fields.
Return structural PASS or a bounded failure state.
stop_conditions: The run or case identity is missing.
References, obligation graph or handoff bundle cannot be resolved.
prohibitions: Do not convert generic SUCCESS into a valid research outcome.
Do not infer proposition truth, external validity or publication status from structural validation.

common_natural_language_intents: 把这些来源材料写成一篇受约束文章。
按之元写作法改写，但保留来源和点火增量边界。
execution_steps: Separate editorial source, external input and Ignition increment with provenance.
Apply the Current writing specification and language-thought boundary.
Return a source-bounded draft, editorial provenance and unmapped residue.
stop_conditions: Source classes or provenance cannot be separated.
Requested wording would exceed the lowest input claim ceiling or require external publication action.
prohibitions: Do not let writing quality raise fact, cause, proof, value or evidence status.
Do not treat Ignition-derived text as an independent source or execute publication hooks.

common_natural_language_intents: 检查这篇 draft 的 publication surface。
核查人类入口、provenance 和导航是否合规。
execution_steps: Bind the publication draft or human-surface entry and its provenance.
Validate declared structure, navigation and surface-level claim boundaries.
Return exact surface findings without substantive acceptance.
stop_conditions: The draft, provenance or target surface cannot be identified.
The request asks the validator to decide truth, quality, acceptance or deployment.
prohibitions: Do not infer content truth, literary quality or publication acceptance from surface validity.
Do not publish, deploy or claim public visibility as capability availability.
